posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Seiya Suzuki belts a 3-run homer in the 6th inning -- his 21st shot of the season. Over his past 40 games, Suzuki has hit .291/.380/.570 with 11 homers, 11 doubles and 42 RBI for the Cubs (through 3 PAs today).
posts.jp: 鈴木誠也が6回に3ラン本塁打を放つ。今季21号。過去40試合で鈴木は打率.291、出塁率.380、長打率.570、11本塁打、11二塁打、42打点（本日3打席まで）。

posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Suzuki added a double in the 8th, giving him a .295/.384/.579 slash line now over his last 40 games. In that period, his season SLG has jumped to .486 from .425, while his season OPS has climbed to .849 from .774.
posts.jp: 鈴木は8回に二塁打を追加。過去40試合での成績は.295/.384/.579に。その間に今季長打率が.425から.486に、OPSが.774から.849に上昇した。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: New Crush City Territory episode Answering listener questions about Dana Brown's future, Tatsuya Imai, prospects, ABS and Jose Altuve YouTube: www.youtube.com/watch?v=rf2V... Apple: podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/c... Spotify: open.spotify.com/episode/6vjv...
posts.jp: New Crush City Territoryの新エピソード。Dana Brownの今後、今井達也、新人、ABSとJose Altuveについてのリスナー質問に回答。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 3-1. They’re doing it without the big blows, but right now? Wins are wins. They’re hot. 60-64.
posts.jp: ブルージェイズが3-1で勝利。派手な得点ではなくても、今は？勝ちは勝ち。好調だ。60勝64敗。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: The Astros won 10-7. They are 63-60. Houston scores five runs off Mariners closer Andrés Muñoz in the 10th inning, capped off by Christian Walker's three-run, walk-off home run.
posts.jp: アストロズが10-7で勝利。63勝60敗。ヒューストンは10回にマリナーズの抑え、ムニョスから5得点。Christian Walkerの3ラン満塁ホームランで試合終了。

posts.author: Jason Beck
posts.text: Tigers manager A.J. Hinch on Jake Rogers, who presumably will join the White Sox in Detroit this weekend: "He's going to be an incredible answer on Immaculate Grid."
posts.jp: タイガース監督A.J.ヒンチがJake Rogersについて。今週末ホワイトソックスがデトロイトで対戦予定：「彼はImmaculate Gridで素晴らしい答えになるだろう」。
